title: A clinical study of sacituzumab tirumotecan in people with ovarian cancer (MK-2870-021)
official: A Phase 3, Randomized, Open-label, Multicenter Study of Sacituzumab Tirumotecan (sac-TMT, MK-2870) Maintenance Treatment With or Without Bevacizumab Versus Standard of Care in Participants With Newly Diagnosed Advanced HRD-Negative Ovarian Cancer Following First-line Platinum-based Chemotherapy (TroFuse-021/ENGOTov85/ GOG-3102)
summary: Main objective: To compare sac-TMT maintenance treatment with or without bevacizumab to SoC, with respect to PFS per RECIST 1.1 as assessed by BICR

interventions.name: Avastin 25 mg/ml concentrate for solution for infusion.
MVASI 25 mg/mL concentrate for solution for infusion

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Has histologically confirmed FIGO Stage III or Stage IV epithelial ovarian, primary peritoneal, or fallopian tube cancer.
2. Has completed primary debulking surgery or interval debulking surgery.
3. Has completed first-line (1L) platinum-based chemotherapy, with a response of stable disease, partial response, or complete response per protocol.
4. Has provided tumor tissue that is not previously irradiated.
5. Has well-controlled human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) with antiretroviral therapy if HIV-infected.
6. Has undetectable hepatitis B virus (HBV) viral load and received HBV antiviral therapy if hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg)-positive.
7. Has undetectable hepatitis C virus (HCV) viral load if has a history of HCV infection.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Has nonepithelial cancers, borderline tumors mucinous, seromucinous that is predominantly mucinous, malignant Brenner's tumor, and undifferentiated carcinoma.
2. Has active infection requiring systemic therapy.
3. Has concurrent and active HBV and HCV infections.
4. Has HIV infection and a history of Kaposi’s sarcoma and/or multicentric Castleman’s disease.
5. Has not recovered from major surgery or has ongoing surgical complications.
6. Has known active central nervous system (CNS) metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis.
7. Has a history of severe eye disease.
8. Has active inflammatory bowel disease requiring immunosuppressive medication or a previous history of inflammatory bowel disease.
9. Has uncontrolled, significant cardiovascular disease or cerebrovascular disease.
10. Has a history of (noninfectious) pneumonitis/interstitial lung disease (ILD), which required steroids, or has current pneumonitis/ILD.
11. Had prior systemic anticancer therapy.
12. Had a live or live-attenuated vaccine within 30 days of randomization.
13. Has a known additional malignancy that is progressing or required active treatment within the past 3 years.
